Wait a minute, haven't WOTC and the DC been saying all along that card
backs are irrelevent and both varieties can be used in the same deck?
Sure, it's dumb, and, yes, it was stupid of them to change the name in
the first place, but it is legal. BTW, one of my friends suggested the
only good way I've heard of for solving the card backs problem: plastic
sleeves with one opaque side, so that the card back would be hidden.
What does everybody else think of this?

Messages.Body:
Andy <al...@pgh.nauticom.net> wrote:
>: |> >Can you guys tell me what's the deal with Camille Devereaux?...
>: |> The rumor around here is that the pose is a rip-off of Steph Seymour's

>: |> pose in a Victora's Secret catalogue.

>I also noticed that Camille is a dead ringer for Steph. As for replacing
>her because of this, it seems rather dumb/silly to me. What, are they
>expecting to get sued?...

Whether we're *expecting* to be sued or not isn't the point. The point is
that we could be sued, so we have to correct the mistake. We can't very well
go around insist that people not trample over our copyrights and such without
respecting others'.
